reader.fix: Put one command per line in both `sh` blocks. Step 2: `mkdir agent-practice` / `cd agent-practice` / `git init` / `claude`. Step 5: `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official` / `mkdir ~/learn-git` / `cd ~/learn-git` / `claude`. Add to step 2: "Run these one line at a time (press Enter after each)."
